# Đường Đến Niết-bàn · The Way to Nibbāna (Nibbānagāminipaṭipadā)

> Digital library of *Nibbānagāminipaṭipadā* by the Most Venerable Meditation Master Pa-Auk Tawya Sayadaw (Pa-Auk Tawya Meditation Centre, Mawlamyine, Mon State, Myanmar). Hosted statically on GitHub Pages at `https://nibbanagamini.org`.

Two editions on the practice of tranquillity (*samatha*) and insight (*vipassanā*) meditation are available:

- **Complete Edition (Bộ Đại, 5 volumes):** Vietnamese translation with Burmese page markers, table of contents, full-text search index, Burmese source PDFs, and offline downloads (PDF, EPUB, HTML, TXT, Markdown).
- **Abridged Edition (Bộ Tóm Lược / Mini, 9 volumes):** Vietnamese, English, and parallel Vietnamese–English editions with Burmese page markers, source images/PDFs, appendices, and offline downloads (PDF, EPUB, HTML, TXT, Markdown, ZIP).

## Important Editorial & License Notice

- **AI Translation Notice:** The Vietnamese and English translations were prepared with the assistance of artificial intelligence (AI), based on the Burmese original by Pa-Auk Tawya Sayadaw and cross-checked against the Chaṭṭhasaṅgāyana edition of the Pāli Tipiṭaka. They are awaiting formal revision or review by senior elders or qualified members of the Saṅgha. Always encourage readers and meditators to cross-check against the Burmese original, Pāli Tipiṭaka (*Pāḷidaw*), and commentaries (*Aṭṭhakathā*).
- **License:** Original Vietnamese/English translations and editorial notes by the project are shared under **CC BY-NC 4.0** (Attribution–NonCommercial 4.0 International); see [/LICENSE](https://nibbanagamini.org/LICENSE). Underlying Burmese originals, source PDFs, fonts, and third-party software keep their own licenses.
- **Content Signals:** `search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no` (declared in [/robots.txt](https://nibbanagamini.org/robots.txt)). Query-time retrieval and citation with attribution are welcomed; model training is not permitted under these preferences.
- **Authentication:** All reading pages, structured JSON data, Markdown downloads, public corrections, and anonymous feedback submission/lookup require **no authentication**. Only the internal human-editor portal (`/review.html`, disallowed in `robots.txt`) uses Firebase Authentication with public sign-up disabled.
- **Editor Contact:** `info@nibbanagamini.org`

## Agent Discovery & Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Sitemap XML](https://nibbanagamini.org/sitemap.xml)
- [Agent Skills Discovery Index (RFC v0.2.0)](https://nibbanagamini.org/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [ARD Capability Manifest (ai-catalog.json)](https://nibbanagamini.org/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- [API Catalog (RFC 9727 Linkset)](https://nibbanagamini.org/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification (Read-only Library JSON Endpoints)](https://nibbanagamini.org/openapi.json)
- [WebMCP Browser Tools](https://nibbanagamini.org/webmcp.js): Registers read-only `list_book_editions`, `search_books`, and `get_book_passage` (plus `get_public_corrections` on `/hieu-dinh.html`) via `document.modelContext.registerTool()`, and exposes declarative HTML form tools (`submit_translation_feedback`, `lookup_feedback_status`) on `/gop-y.html`.
